title: englerastrum alstonianum
intro: Englerastrum alstonianum, commonly known as the St. Paul's wort, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It is a perennial herb with a long history of traditional use, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Englerastrum alstonianum include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic activities, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Englerastrum alstonianum on human health, but current studies suggest its potential in treating various health conditions.
